atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RPG pixel-art sprite atlas, NOT an illustration. Supporting reference: attached character sprite sheet is the exact required pixel-art fidelity and view. Create a single transparent atlas of TWELVE isolated game objects, exactly 4 evenly spaced columns by 3 evenly spaced rows, row-major order given below. Each object completely within its own cell, generous EMPTY transparent gutters separating all rows and columns, no text or labels, no floor, no shadows outside the object, no scenery. Unified orthographic top-down RPG three-quarter view (camera looks south-facing objects from above, see their top surfaces and front face; front horizontal edges perfectly horizontal, side verticals vertical, NO rotated isometric diamonds, NO diagonal oblique view, NO visible right or left side face). Hand-placed chunky low-resolution pixel art like 32x44px character reference. Crisp single pixel outlines, small warm wood palette, slate-blue metal, cream fabric, desaturated greens, lighting upper left. Restrained 3-shade ramps, no painting, no smooth gradients, no realistic texture, no glossy 3D rendering. Every object one consistent camera and art style. Draw large block pixels so sprite could be faithfully reduced to about 32 to 64 pixels tall (large beds 72px); avoid tiny detail. Objects in each row should have aligned bottoms. Row 1: narrow single wooden bed pointing north with blue blanket and white pillow at top (top-down rectangular mattress, headboard top, footboard bottom); matching narrow single medical wooden bed pointing north with green blanket and white pillow at top; simple wooden chair facing south with visible seat top; tiny wooden bedside cabinet with candle on top, same view as beds. Row 2: long wooden dining table with one bench along its north and one along its south edge, no chairs; plain rectangular common-room wooden table; rectangular workshop table with a vise and two tools on top; small simple square wooden stool. Row 3: wooden garden bench facing south; low closed wooden storage chest with metal straps; narrow wooden two-door cabinet; simple white medical privacy screen with three vertical panels on small wheels.
